items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: My girlfriend lived there, a girl named Maud

ctx.x:
making arrangements.
And this is where I really heard Jabbo, man. He came in there, and man, I tell you, he took that place... Gangsters owned the place. It was a race horse bookie during the daytime, and it was a nightclub at night. So we didn't start until 11 o'clock at night. And Jabbo was at his height. Good-lookin' man. He was so sharp, it hurt, man. He wore them black ascot ties, and all of the ladies in town were after him, and he loved it.

And I remember, he had to be living... Now, we were Downtown, at State and Lake Street, over there some place, and he was the South Side, down on 46th Street or 47th Street. My girlfriend lived there, a girl named Maud, and Jabbo lived in the apartment next door to her. Now, we were supposed to hit at 11 o'clock at night, and Jabbo was never there, and I'd have to call this girl and ask her if he could go over there and get him up. Now, of course, he wasn't going to go down to the job until about 12:30. Well, the…

So the next season, they just gave up on him and hired Cassino Simpson to be the leader, and then Jabbo went on some place else, and we stayed there with Cassino, and we finally played the Regal and got to make some pictures, and
